display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index (NREM): (Apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with no oxygen desaturation used and with or without arousal) / hour of NREM sleep from type I polysomnography
description: Calculated - RDI in NREM sleep (>= 0% desaturation)
calculation: 60*(hnrbp + hnrop + canbp + canop + oanbp +oanop + manrbp + manrop)/(slpprdp - minremp)
